moving_parts.rate: 60 Hz (displacer inside cold finger, driven by the pressure wave)
moving_parts.quote: The oscillating pressure wave generated by the piston passes from the pressure vessel into the cold finger causing the displacer inside the cold finger to move.

moving_parts.rate: 60 Hz, up to 5 mm amplitude (passive balancer counter-mass on pressure-vessel end)
moving_parts.quote: The maximum amplitude of the balancer's oscillation is 5 mm.

notes: Standard CT system (manual Table 3-1): cooler P/N 100215, passive balancer 100903, Gen II controller 100870 (116 x 98 x 65 mm, 490 g), RTD with wire 100300, RTD cable 100880, cooler power cable 100887, RS-232 cable 100884. Mass 3.1 kg with balancer, 2.6 kg without. Nominal input 160 W, lift 11 W at 77 K / 23 C reject, stability +/-0.1 K, any orientation, can operate in vacuum, MTTF 200,000 h. Manual states a minimum load of about 4 W at 77 K for gas-bearing operation. The 296 K heat-rejector stage is the 23 C reject condition from the lift spec, not a measured plate. The two-conductor power cable is filed under heater_lead for lack of a drive-lead enum; it carries alternator drive power. The three moving_parts entries describe one 60 Hz free-piston mechanism: piston (pressure vessel), displacer (cold finger), passive balancer (counter-mass).
